app.title: AHub — Ikigo cy'Ubuhinzi n'Ubworozi
portals.rab.title: Ikigo cy'Ubuhinzi (RAB Admin)
portals.rab.description: Gucunga ibiciro bya leta, amatangazo y'igihugu, konti z'intara, n'ikoranabuhanga.
portals.province.title: Ibiro by'Ubworozi mu Ntara (Province Vet)
portals.province.description: Gucunga icyorezo, kwemeza konti z'uturere, n'ingamba z'ubworozi mu ntara.
portals.district.title: Ibiro by'Ubworozi mu Karere (District Vet)
portals.district.description: Gucunga ibyorezo mu karere, kwemeza konti z'imurenge, n'inkingo.
portals.sector.title: Agronome n'Umuveti mu Murenge (Sector Officer)
portals.sector.description: Kwandika abahinzi, gukurikirana abahinzi, n'ibibazo by'amatungo.
portals.nsg.title: Umutekano n'Ubugenzuzi (NSG Security)
portals.nsg.description: Kugenzura umutekano wa sisitemu, gukurikirana ibikorwa (audit logs).
portals.farmer.title: Konti y'Umuhinzi / Umworozi (Farmer)
portals.farmer.description: Gukurikirana ibihingwa, amatungo, teganya ikirere n'isoko.
portals.customer.title: Konti y'Umuguzi / Isoko (Customer)
portals.customer.description: Shaka umusaruro w'ubuhinzi mu murenge cyangwa akarere wifuza.
auth.approvalNotice: Konti z'abayobozi (Intara, Akarere, Umurenge, Security) bisaba kwemezwa n'urwego rubakuriye. Nyuma yo kwemezwa, ubona ikode y'ubwemerere.
auth.farmerOtpNotice: Abahinzi binjira bakoresheje nimero ya terefone na OTP.
